description: At or above this aggregate detectability the evidence is Sufficient.
Below this the evidence is Insufficient; between the two it is Marginal.
A detection above this settles the item on its own, without absence reasoning.
Below this a detection is not acted on.
Required posterior probability of true absence before a violation may be asserted.
Below this an absence claim is not entertained at all.
Default share of a target's extent that must be observed for spatial completeness.
Coverage below which a spatial-completeness item is not even marginal.
Prior probability that a required condition holds before any observation.
Discount applied to each additional viewpoint's independent contribution.
Half-life of evidence validity; older observations are down-weighted.
Logit gain per doubling of pixels on target.
Logit penalty, scaled by the class occlusion sensitivity and the occluded fraction.
Logit penalty per unit of (1 - cos incidence).
